title: Extending Lower Bounds to Blockcipher-Based Robust Encryption
summary: Known lower bounds for r-BIND-secure encryptment extend to sr-BIND security; it remains open whether analogous lower bounds hold for blockcipher-based robust encryption.

formal_statement.body: The unresolved task is to determine whether the lower bounds known for $r$-BIND-secure encryptment schemes extend to blockcipher-based robust encryption schemes. The lower-bound results are stated for $r$-BIND security, and they also extend to $sr$-BIND security because $sr$-BIND security implies $r$-BIND security; the open question is whether an analogous extension reaches the blockcipher-based robust-encryption model.

scope.domain: Design of cryptographic primitives involving encryptment and blockcipher-based robust encryption.
parameters: r-BIND and sr-BIND, security notions framing the known lower bounds
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether the known lower bounds extend to blockcipher-based robust encryption schemes.

citations.label: Fast Message Franking: From Invisible Salamanders to Encryptment

progress.summary: The source presents lower bounds for r-BIND-secure encryptment schemes and notes that they extend to sr-BIND security because sr-BIND implies r-BIND. It then conjectures an extension to blockcipher-based robust encryption schemes and leaves it open.
citation_labels: Yevgeniy Dodis et al., Fast Message Franking: From Invisible Salamanders to Encryptment
